company.name: Orchid Labs
company.shortDescription: Orchid Labs is an open-source project committed to ending surveillance and censorship on the internet.
company.description: Orchid Labs is an open-source project committed to ending surveillance and censorship on the internet. Orchid uses an overlay network built upon the existing internet, which is driven by a peer-to-peer tokenized bandwidth exchange, creating a more inclusive, liberated internet. Orchid Labs was founded in 2017 by Dr. Steven Waterhouse, Jay Freeman,  Brian J. Fox, Gustav Simonsson, and Stephen Bell.
